Food Safety - Haccp Principles

CRITICAL CONTROL POINTS & MONITORING:

RECEIVING:

☐ Temperature checked upon receipt

- Refrigerated: ≤ 41°F (5°C)

- Frozen: ≤ 0°F (-18°C)

- Hot foods: ≥ 135°F (57°C)

☐ Packages inspected for damage, leaks, pests

☐ Reject if temperature abuse or damage

☐ Receiving log maintained

STORAGE:

☐ Cold storage temperatures monitored twice daily

- Refrigerator: 38-40°F (3-4°C)

- Freezer: 0°F (-18°C) or below

☐ Dry storage: 50-70°F (10-21°C), humidity controlled

☐ FIFO (First In, First Out) rotation practiced

☐ All items labeled and dated

☐ No raw meat above ready-to-eat foods

☐ Food stored 6" off floor

PREPARATION:

☐ Thawing: refrigerator, cold running water, or microwave (if cooked immediately)

☐ No thawing at room temperature

☐ Separate cutting boards/utensils for raw and ready-to-eat

☐ Wash/sanitize equipment between uses

COOKING:

☐ Minimum internal cooking temperatures:

- Poultry: 165°F (74°C) for 15 seconds

- Ground meats: 155°F (68°C) for 15 seconds

- Pork, beef, fish: 145°F (63°C) for 15 seconds

- Eggs: 155°F (68°C) for 15 seconds (if hot held)

- Reheated foods: 165°F (74°C) for 15 seconds

☐ Temperatures verified with calibrated probe thermometer

☐ Cooking logs maintained

HOLDING:

☐ Hot holding: ≥ 135°F (57°C)

☐ Cold holding: ≤ 41°F (5°C)

☐ Temperatures checked every 2 hours

☐ Time as a public health control used if applicable (4-hour limit)

COOLING:

☐ Cool from 135°F to 70°F (57°C to 21°C) within 2 hours

☐ Cool from 70°F to 41°F (21°C to 5°C) within 4 hours (6 hours total)

☐ Cooling methods: ice baths, shallow pans, blast chillers, stirring

REHEATING:

☐ Reheat to 165°F (74°C) within 2 hours

☐ Reheat only once

SERVING:

☐ Use clean, sanitized utensils

☐ No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food

☐ Sneezeguards in place for self-service

☐ Single-use gloves changed:

- After each task

- Every 4 hours minimum

- After handling raw food

- After touching non-food surfaces

- After breaks

TOP 9 ALLERGENS:

1. Milk 2. Eggs 3. Peanuts 4. Tree Nuts 5. Soy

6. Wheat 7. Fish 8. Shellfish 9. Sesame

☐ Surfaces thoroughly cleaned between preparations

☐ Handwashing between handling allergens

☐ Allergen-free items prepared first or in separate area

☐ Packaging/labels checked for allergen information

☐ Students with allergies identified (with permission)

Cleaning & Sanitizing

THREE-COMPARTMENT SINK PROCEDURE:

SINK 1: WASH

- Water temperature: 110°F (43°C)

- Detergent used

- Scrub to remove soil

SINK 2: RINSE

- Clean water to remove detergent

SINK 3: SANITIZE

- Chemical sanitizer (concentration checked with test strips)

☐ Chlorine: 50-100 ppm, 50°F+ (contact time: 7 seconds for immersion, 10-30 seconds for wiping)

☐ Quaternary ammonia: per manufacturer (usually 200-400 ppm)

☐ Iodine: 12.5-25 ppm

- OR Hot water: 171°F+ (77°C+) for 30 seconds

☐ Air dry - do not towel dry

WAREWASHER (MECHANICAL):

☐ High-temperature: Final rinse 180°F (82°C) for stationary rack, 165°F (74°C) for conveyor

☐ Chemical sanitizing: Concentration checked regularly

☐ Temperature gauges working

☐ Rack covers clean
